articles.title: Indian Air Force Delivers 21 Tonnes Of Relief Material To Sri Lanka Reeling From Floods, Landslides
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force recently delivered 21 tonnes of relief material, along with over 80 NDRF personnel and 8 tonnes of equipment, to Sri Lanka. This humanitarian aid aims to assist those displaced by devastating floods, showcasing India's prompt response capabilities and commitment to regional stability and assistance in times of crisis. Such operations highlight the multi-faceted role of our armed forces.

articles.title: Indian Rescue Forces Land on Island with Tons of Aid (Photos)
articles.summary: An Indian rescue forces battalion has arrived in Sri Lanka, landing at Bandaranaike International Airport via a special Indian Air Force Ilyushin-76 aircraft. This deployment highlights India's proactive role in regional humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) operations, utilizing its defence capabilities to support neighbouring nations. The mission reinforces India's commitment as a reliable first responder.

articles.title: Venezuela's Maduro has his own Jill Biden and a coven of communist hags surrounding him
articles.summary: The article critiques the 'leftist trope' suggesting female leadership guarantees global peace, using Venezuela's current political and economic struggles under its ruling 'claque' as a counter-example. It implies a broader political analysis, arguing against simplistic solutions to complex governance challenges, and highlights the real-world consequences of specific leadership types on a nation's stability and prosperity.

articles.title: Navy will play a decisive role in securing India's destiny, says CDS General Anil Chauhan
articles.summary: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan addressed newly inducted Naval officers at their passing out parade from the Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala. He underscored the Indian Navy's strategic positioning, vital for safeguarding national interests and ensuring maritime security in a complex geopolitical environment. This highlights the critical role of naval power for aspiring officers.

articles.title: Lili Reinhart Reveals She Feels 'Suicidal' The Week Before Her Period Due to PMDD
articles.summary: Actress Lili Reinhart, 29, known for 'Hal & Harper,' candidly discussed her mental health journey on Monica Lewinsky's 'Reclaiming' podcast. Her appearance aimed to foster open conversations about mental well-being, sharing personal insights. This public discussion by a prominent figure contributes to destigmatizing mental health issues, offering relatable perspectives to a wide audience and encouraging transparency.

articles.title: NISAR satellite deploys 12-metre diameter antenna, enters science phase
articles.summary: The NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) satellite, launched aboard GSLV-F16 on July 30, has successfully deployed its crucial 12-metre diameter antenna reflector. ISRO confirmed NISAR has now officially entered its science phase, marking a significant milestone for this joint Earth-observing mission. This collaboration aims to provide unprecedented data for studying climate change and natural hazards.

articles.title: India’s blockbuster 8.2% Q2 GDP growth beats expectations. But is it enough to lift the markets?
articles.summary: India has solidified its position as the fastest-growing major economy globally. This impressive performance is attributed to robust domestic demand, moderating inflation, and a six-month high in labour force participation. Such economic resilience underscores India's internal strength and progressive trajectory, vital for national development and securing its strategic interests across all domains, including defence preparedness.

articles.title: Operation Sagar Bandhu: India dispatches 12 tonnes of humanitarian aid to Colombo
articles.summary: India expanded its humanitarian outreach to Sri Lanka, deploying an Indian Air Force C-130J aircraft to Colombo. The aircraft delivered nearly 12 tonnes of crucial relief material, continuing assistance under an ongoing operation. This initiative underscores India's commitment to regional stability and its role as a first responder in the neighbourhood, leveraging military assets for humanitarian aid, important for an SSB aspirant to understand.

articles.title: December 2025 Calendar: Check Full List Of National, International Days And Events
articles.summary: The article introduces December 2025 as the year's final month, comprising 31 days. It highlights December's role in bringing holidays and providing a crucial period for reflection on the year's events and personal progress. This end-of-year marker encourages self-assessment and forward planning, essential for SSB aspirants to review their annual achievements and strategize for future goals.

articles.title: On This Date in 1944: Hal Newhouser Starts His Trek Towards the Hall of Fame as the Tigers Dominate Starting Pitching
articles.summary: In 1944, a unique event unfolded in the American League MVP vote as two Detroit Tigers fiercely competed for the top award. Hal Newhouser ultimately triumphed, securing the prestigious title by a narrow margin. This historical sporting moment underscored intense internal team rivalry and individual excellence within national baseball.

articles.title: Parkston's Oakley, Burke's Hausmann named to Class B volleyball all-state team
articles.summary: Mitchell-area athletes Keeara Oakley (Parkston) and Emmie Hausmann (Burke) have been recognized as Class B all-state second-team performers in volleyball, as chosen by the South Dakota Volleyball Coaches Association. This news highlights the achievements of young athletes at a state level within competitive sports, celebrating their dedication and skill in a specific sporting discipline.

articles.title: Yankees fans react as reliever Nick Burdi heads to the Mets
articles.summary: Yankees fans are reportedly restless as winter begins, driven by weeks of speculation and mixed signals from the team's ownership. Every minor development regarding the team's direction has become a major talking point among supporters, reflecting their anxiety and heightened interest in decisions affecting the club's future performance and player roster.
